text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me to join you,
Trainer.
This has been just the change of
pace I needed.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My schedule has been a little too full of
late, so I
welcome the—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: President! There you are!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ah, Эйр Грув. How can I help?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Is the draft for the revisions to this year's
event
schedule complete?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
If I'm not mistaken, we decided at the
last council
meeting that you would
write the outline and I
would do the rest.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Oh... Is that right?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...President?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Sorry, it's nothing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I believe I left it in my dorm room.
Would you be
so kind as to wait in the
student council office for
a moment?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...Yes, of course.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: ...Well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: This is quite the quandary...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: Did you forget to do it?

text_block_list.text:
Quite the opposite, actually. I finished
the whole
thing.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The form is already finalized and
proofread.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: To be clear, I didn't forget I had to hand it over to Эйр Грув. But the work was progressing so smoothly that, in the heat of the moment...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: In a word, yes.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Эйр Грув won't be pleased. She's warned me more than once about monopolizing the student council workload...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I think we can come up with some kind of story.
We should be honest with her.

text_block_list.text:
Do you mean... deceive her? I could
never...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But, then again... Yes, I see. The truth
would only
cause her needless anxiety.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Your counsel is wise as always. I see now
that the
high road is not always the best
one.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It's settled, then. We will keep this a
secret from
Эйр Грув—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: And what secret is that, President?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: A-Эйр Грув! I didn't see you there!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I thought you were acting oddly, so I
came back,
and what do I find but you
two conspiring!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It seems you both need to be reminded
of the
virtues of honesty!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: As promised, we both receive a very thorough lecture from Эйр Грув.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And risk her wrath? Surely not. When
the Empress
rages, even the Emperor
quails...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So she says, but is it really so bad to
have friends
willing to keep you in line?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: It sounds like she cares about you.

text_block_list.text: Hm? Haha, perhaps she does!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Although her "care" can be fearsome at
times! Ha
ha ha!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Is this really a laughing matter?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Well, there's nothing for it but to face
the music.
I'll be back once I have made
my apologies.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So, it would appear you did everything
yourself...
again.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
How many times have I told you that we
need to
share the workload? You truly
are hopeless.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I have nothing to say in my defense. I
can only
apologize.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Those who lead have a duty to delegate
labor
appropriately. I see that now.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Well, there is that.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But seeing as you clearly feel remorse, I
suppose I
can refrain from scolding you
further.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
However, I would like you to bear one
thing in
mind.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Yes?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Just as you strive for the happiness of all
the
students...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
So too do we hope for yours. Remember
that.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...And as she said that, I realized
something.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I still have a long way to go as a leader.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Симболи Рудольф's voice is low, but there's
a smile
on her lips.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haha... I'm terribly sorry. I would not
trade your
scoldings for the world.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
